message:
W3 #134 composition fix: break-drain canary — time travels on the clock, not on a snapshot (assertions unchanged)

CI run 41035980012 on 0fad652: CallMidSessionRepositoryTest > safeBreak_doesNotDrainDuringACall failed — the only out-of-floor failure (36 total, the rest shared floor incl. main-side surge failures). Root cause is compositional, not behavioural: since issue #33, updateSessionProgress computes from the row as it stands in the database (the caller's snapshot only names the session), so the test's part-2 technique of ageing a snapshot copy (lastTick − 601s) no longer moves time — the stored row's anchor stood at the hold instant and the break truthfully did not drain. On the lane's original base (0a00e95, pre-wrapper) the snapshot WAS the input, so it passed there.

Fix follows the lane's own fixture-correction precedent (ec408a5, and the in-file uptime correction): the scenario now advances Robolectric's monotonic clock 601s before the post-hang-up tick, so the stored row's anchor is genuinely 601s old when the machine reads it. Every requirement assertion is byte-identical; no production code changes.
